name: warpos
description: WarpOS — autonomous AI operating system for software engineering. Registry-driven hooks, transactional updates, honest release gates, generic promotion.
notes: Manifest-regen fix. 0.4.2's install.ps1 copied the canonical's framework-manifest.json into product repos (473 assets), but /warp:doctor's manifest_stale check compares the local file to what generate-framework-manifest.js produces when run locally — which includes product-specific commands/agents (488+). So 0.4.2 installs always reported manifest_stale yellow. 0.4.3 replaces the static copy with a target-side regen: install.ps1 runs `node scripts/generate-framework-manifest.js` in the target after copying assets, producing a manifest that reflects the product's actual file tree. Fallback to canonical-copy on a fresh install where the generator isn't on target yet. Re-bootstrap any product repo to clear the doctor yellow.
